rationale_md: Spain enters this Group H clash as overwhelming favorites, backed by a massive 370-point Elo rating advantage that reflects the gulf in quality between a European powerhouse and an Asian side still developing on the world stage. The model assigns La Roja an 81% win probability, suggesting this should be a comfortable outing for Spain to collect three crucial points in their group campaign. Saudi Arabia faces an uphill battle to avoid defeat, with even a draw appearing unlikely given their 5% chance of pulling off what would be a stunning upset.
